SELECT s.id AS s_id, s.province_id AS s_province_id, s.city_id AS s_city_id, s.address AS s_address, s.so2_value AS s_so2_value, s.so2_level AS s_so2_level, s.co_value AS s_co_value, s.co_level AS s_co_level, s.spm_value AS s_spm_value, s.spm_level AS s_spm_level, s.aqi_id AS s_aqi_id, s.confirm_date AS s_confirm_date, s.confirm_time AS s_confirm_time, s.gm_id AS s_gm_id, s.fd_id AS s_fd_id, s.information AS s_information, s.remarks AS s_remarks,
gp.province_id AS gp_province_id, gp.province_name AS gp_province_name, gp.province_abbr AS gp_province_abbr,
gc.city_id AS gc_city_id, gc.city_name AS gc_city_name, gc.province_id AS gc_province_id,
aq.aqi_id AS aq_aqi_id, aq.chinese_explain AS aq_chinese_explain, aq.aqi_explain AS aq_aqi_explain, aq.color AS aq_color, aq.health_impact AS aq_health_impact, aq.take_steps AS aq_take_steps, aq.so2_min AS aq_so2_min, aq.so2_max AS aq_so2_max, aq.co_min AS aq_co_min, aq.co_max AS aq_co_max, aq.spm_min AS aq_spm_min, aq.spm_max AS aq_spm_max,
gm.gm_id AS gm_gm_id, gm.gm_name AS gm_gm_name, gm.gm_code AS gm_gm_code, gm.password AS gm_password, gm.province_id AS gm_province_id, gm.city_id AS gm_city_id, gm.tel AS gm_tel, gm.state AS gm_state FROM statistics s INNER JOIN grid_province gp ON s.province_id = gp.province_id INNER JOIN grid_city gc ON s.city_id = gc.city_id INNER JOIN aqi aq ON s.aqi_id = aq.aqi_id LEFT JOIN grid_member gm ON s.gm_id = gm.gm_id
AND s.province_id = #{provinceId} AND s.city_id = #{cityId} AND s.confirm_date LIKE CONCAT('%',#{confirmDate},'%')
ORDER BY s.id DESC LIMIT #{beginNum},#{maxPageNum}

SELECT gp.province_id AS provinceId, gp.province_abbr AS provinceAbbr, gp.province_name AS provinceName, IFNULL(SUM(s.so2_value),0) AS so2Total, IFNULL(SUM(s.co_value),0) AS coTotal, IFNULL(SUM(s.spm_value),0) AS spmTotal, COUNT(s.id) AS aqiTotal FROM grid_province gp LEFT JOIN statistics s ON gp.province_id = s.province_id GROUP BY gp.province_id,gp.province_abbr,gp.province_name
SELECT a.aqi_id AS aqiId, a.aqi_explain AS aqiExplain, COUNT(s.id) AS total FROM aqi a LEFT JOIN statistics s ON a.aqi_id = s.aqi_id GROUP BY a.aqi_id,a.aqi_explain
